note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content of the transcript and the DDx JSON.

Please provide:
- The full transcript text (doctor-patient dialogue).
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format.

Once received, I will produce:

Subjective:
- Presenting complaints (onset/duration/progression), history of presenting illness
- Past medical history, medications (if stated), allergies
- Social history (if stated)
- Other relevant subjective info from the transcript

Objective:
- Physical examination findings (with site/location, laterality, and specifics)
- Any documented investigations or results (if provided)

Assessment & Plan:
- For each identified issue/condition (1, 2, 3, ...), include:
  - Issue name (one per section)
  - Assessment/likely diagnosis (name only)
  - Differential diagnoses (from DDx only if consistent with transcript; mark conflict if applicable)
  - Investigations planned (if stated)
  - Treatments planned (if stated)
  - Referrals (if stated)

Quality checks (to be included at bottom):
- Missing but clinically expected elements (e.g., complete meds/allergies reconciliation)
- Internal conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted”)
- Brief note on transcript quality (noisy/inaudible, etc.)

Notes:
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and append “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- I will not infer facts beyond what is in the transcript or DDx, and I will explicitly flag any conflicts between transcript and DDx.
